title: Add a panel to a dashboard

blocks.content:
Before you can write a query, you need a panel on your dashboard. In this milestone, you add a new panel and open the panel editor.

To add a panel to an existing dashboard, complete the following steps:

1. Open a dashboard in Grafana.
2. Click **Edit** in the top-right corner of the dashboard to enter edit mode.
3. Click the **Add** button (the blue plus icon) in the toolbar.
4. Select **Visualization** from the dropdown.

The panel editor opens with a new, empty panel.
In the next milestone, you select the Grafana data source for your panel.
